## Summary

Replaced the global `fetch` in `src/ingress/admin.ts` with `node:http`'s `request`, which no longer sends `Sec-Fetch-Mode: cors` (the header that made Caddy 2.11.4's origin enforcement answer 403 to every admin call).

**`src/ingress/admin.ts`**
- Private helper now uses `httpRequest` with `agent: false` so no kept-alive socket outlives a request.
- `load` sends only `Content-Type: application/json` and `Content-Length`; `getConfig` sends no extra headers.
- `error` events map to `AdminUnreachableError` using `error.code` (e.g. `ECONNREFUSED`), else the message.
- Non-2xx still maps to `AdminRequestError` with the first body line; empty 200 body returns `null`.
- All exports, class names, messages and the `CaddyAdmin` interface are unchanged.

**`tests/ingress-admin-headers.test.ts`** (new) — a local `node:http` server that mimics Caddy's 403-on-browser-header behavior, covering all six acceptance lines, including verifying the source no longer references `fetch`.

Verification: task verify (36 tests) passed; proposal verify `pnpm verify` passed (tsc + 339 tests). Result written to `openspec/changes/010-ingress-fixes/.run/results/1.md`.
